name: memoir-desktop
description: Memoir — local scrapbook-style memoir drafting with AI
author: Memoir

scripts.build:renderer: npm run clean:renderer && npm --prefix ../app run build && node -e "require('./build-utils.cjs').validateRendererBuild()"
scripts.package: npm run prepare:model && npm run clean:dist && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir
scripts.dist: npm run prepare:model && npm run clean:dist && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win dir zip
scripts.dist:single-file: npm run prepare:model && npm run clean:dist && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win portable
